name: Molecular Quantum Solutions
description: Molecular Quantum Solutions (MQS) is a Danish quantum chemistry software company providing computational platforms that combine HPC and quantum methods to predict molecular properties for pharmaceutical, biotech, materials, and chemical R&D customers. Its Cebule Dashboard targets formulation chemistry rather than primary drug discovery, complementing traditional quantum chemistry tooling. MQS is backed by Scale Capital, Stokbro Invest, Rockstart, and Rockstart Emerging Tech, and co-organized the 2025 Quantum Innovation Challenge with the BioInnovation Institute.

news.title: Europe's Quantum Ecosystem #1? How MQS is Leading the way for Denmark
news.excerpt: Copenhagen-based startup Molecular Quantum Solutions (MQS) is applying quantum chemistry and quantum computing to real-world problems in formulation chemistry. The company, founded in 2019, has built the Cebule platform for pharma, biotech, and chemical industries, and is collaborating with Japanese tech giant Fujitsu while building commercial ties in North America, Australia, and across the EU.
